Comment_SearchRadius: How far the mod looks for nearby dropped items to combine.
Comment_InitializeRecoveryDelayMs: How long the mod waits before checking dropped items when initialized (loading world, etc..) .
Comment_CollisionRetryDelayMs: How long the mod waits before trying again if an item landed but was still moving.
Comment_BlacklistedItemCodes: Full collectible codes that should never be clumped.
